component.name: Daily
component.summary: Local-first signed-graph habit tracker & rhythm observer
Lokaler Habit-Tracker mit Graph-Routing, Liquid ODE & E2EE-Sync

description.p: Daily is a calm, local-first habit and daily-rhythm tracker with zero presets, zero cloud accounts, and zero telemetry.

ul.li: Arbitrary signed (+/-) live graph routing between habits
Continuous-time Liquid Relaxation ODE and optional local TabPFN v2 / XGBoost insights
Sparse Momentaufnahme mood & state snapshots with custom axes and groups
Optional AES-256-GCM end-to-end encrypted multi-device sync (WebDAV or private Gist)

screenshot.caption: Today view — signed habit cards, live routing, and interleaved mood log
Analysis view — TabPFN v2 and Continuous-Time Liquid ODE curves

description.p: Initial public beta release: signed live graph routing, compact habit groups, adaptive mood state curves, Liquid Relaxation ODE, and AES-256-GCM multi-device sync.
